title: A current minimizing in A is not beaten by adding an integer multiplicity cycle supported in A ∩ W (Simon 7.2.4 (9))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, A ⊆ ℝ^P, W ⊆ ℝ^P open with W ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContained W U), and K ⊆ ℝ^P compact with K ⊆ A ∩ W. Let S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be minimizing in A (IsMinimizingIn S A), and let X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) be integer multiplicity with ∂X = 0 and spt X ⊆ K. Then M_W(S) ≤ M_W(S + X|_U). Here X|_U := X.restrictDomain (U ⊆ ℝ^P) ∈ 𝒟_n(U), so X|_U(ω) = X(ιω) with ι = testFormOnInclusion, and S + X|_U means S − (0 − X|_U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U A W K : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn S A → IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.boundary = 0 → IsCompact K → X.support ⊆ K → K ⊆ A ∩ W → S.massOn W ≤ (S - (0 - X.restrictDomain (subset_univ U))).massOn W
